history.content: Design a single-floor home, plot 30 feet wide and 30 feet long, south-facing entrance. Exactly 1 bedrooms and 1 bathrooms total. All bathrooms are common, no attached bathrooms. Include living room, separate dining room, kitchen. No parking. Keep hallway space compact, bedrooms balanced, and kitchen next to dining. Record these requirements and prepare to generate.

Great, I’ve logged a 30 × 30 ft plot with a south‑facing entrance, a single bedroom, one common bathroom, and a ground‑floor layout that includes a living room, separate dining room, and kitchen. No attached bathrooms or parking have been requested, and the hallway will stay compact.

When you’re ready, just click “Generate 3D home,” and let me know if you’d like any final tweaks before we proceed.
